hero.heading: SAY YES IN SCOTLAND'S MOST EXCLUSIVE BOUTIQUE
hero.subheading: Curated bridal couture in the heart of Glasgow

about.heading: Intimate, relaxed, and entirely about you.
about.paragraph1: Located in Glasgow's prestigious West Regent Street, The Bridal Courtyard offers an exclusive bridal shopping experience. With full private use of our boutique, you and your guests can explore our handpicked collection of world-renowned designers in total luxury.
about.paragraph2: From clean modern minimalism to timeless romance, every gown in our boutique is chosen for its exceptional craftsmanship and distinctive design.

lindsay.title: MEET LINDSAY
lindsay.subtitle: Owner & Principal Stylist
lindsay.bio: With years of expertise in luxury bridal styling, Lindsay created The Bridal Courtyard to offer brides a personal, pressure-free sanctuary. Every consultation is tailored to your unique vision, ensuring you feel radiant and truly yourself.
